The video shows a man speaking at a table, stating that the KPU server has automatically given the number one pair (Joko Widodo-Ma'ruf Amin) 57% of the votes. The man also mentions that there is a rapat (meeting) taking place during the speech.

However, the KPU chairman, Arief Budiman, has denied any wrongdoing and stated that there are no KPU servers outside of the country.
